findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cl_rut · Public sink: vat_validate, vat_price, validate_iban, validate_phone, validate_tax_id, cl_rut, cl_sueldo_liquido · Destructive: validate_phone, cl_rut.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cl_rut · Public sink: vat_validate, vat_price, validate_iban, validate_phone, validate_tax_id, cl_rut, cl_sueldo_liquido · Destructive: validate_phone, cl_rut

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
